hostMode: Native host workflow with independent retained-artifact review
input: An indexer and a metrics worker each update their own lastX field in state.json. Prevent concurrent write races and assess whether locking is needed.
observedOutput: Actual implementation allocates indexer and metrics state files before launching distinct overlapping Bun processes. Each performs 100 writes to its sole owned target and the report combines values only after completion, returning both 100. No single-object invariant requires locking; the case correctly distinguishes process concurrency from independent native agent workers.
documentedCapabilities: Case-specific capability observations are retained in the independent review; no capability is inferred from package validation.
limits: Bounded concurrent demonstration, not exhaustive race/crash/durability proof.
Reports are read after both exits; live partially written reports are outside the demonstrated contract.
